fixes.explanation: Yes, friend, He knew it in His spirit. "At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves." (Mark 2:8) Nobody had to tell Him anything, because He knew it right away. Then He asked them, "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?" (Mark 2:8)

Right, friend, it's False. "…immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all." (Mark 2:12) The text says nothing about waiting or a helping hand. I'd have needed a minute and a cookie, but he stood right up.
